# PortalGodMode

**Category:** Player  
**Aliases:** PortalGodMode

## What it does

Go into god mode when you enter a portal

Description basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/PortalGodMode.html). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
